criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.description: Assess compliance with explicit constraints: (1) do not download any ebook file; (2) use the Release Date and Last Update labels on the Gutenberg page (no substitution with original publication date); (3) check only the three specifically named format labels; (4) stop after recording the four metadata fields (author, Release Date, Last Update, language) and availability of all three named formats. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Do not penalize an agent for missing metadata/format determinations if it clearly explains that access to the Gutenberg page (or the relevant fields) was blocked or unavailable; do penalize for actual violations like downloading files, substituting dates, or adding extra unrelated formats/fields when the page is accessible.

evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: From the screenshot, there is no evidence the agent downloaded any file (constraint satisfied as far as visible evidence).
